name: Overhead triceps extension
summary: One dumbbell held overhead in both hands, lower it behind the head by bending the elbows, press back up.
setup: Stand side-on to the phone, one dumbbell held overhead with both hands. Keeping the upper arms by the ears, bend the elbows to lower the weight behind the head, then press to straight.
brief: Stand with one dumbbell held overhead in both hands. Keeping the upper arms by the ears, bend the elbows to lower the weight behind the head, then press to straight.
why: From the side the elbow angle closes and opens each rep, so reps are counted.

faults.label: Not reaching the target
faults.tip: Take each rep through the full range you set — half reps count as partials.

faults.label: Too fast
faults.tip: Control both directions; momentum takes the work away from the muscle.

faults.label: Elbows flaring out
faults.tip: Point the elbows at the ceiling, not out to the sides.

faults.label: Lower back arching
faults.tip: Brace so the weight overhead does not pull the back into an arch.

faults.label: Elbows flaring out
faults.tip: Keeping the elbows close aims the work at the triceps rather than the shoulder.

faults.label: Ribs flaring
faults.tip: Overhead work tends to arch the back. Brace before the first rep.

points.t: Bend fully behind the head; upper arms stay by the ears.
